title: Abelian group
description: A group whose operation is commutative.

title: Absolute Galois group
description: The group Gal(F^sep/F), with its Krull topology, where F^sep is a separable closure.

title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for complex inner-product spaces
description: In a complex inner-product space, |⟨u,v⟩|²≤⟨u,u⟩⟨v,v⟩ for all u,v.

title: Convex hull
description: The smallest convex set containing a given set of points.

title: Drinfeld center of a monoidal category
description: For a monoidal category C, its center Z(C) has objects (X,c), where c is a half-braiding on X, and morphisms f:X→X′ compatible with the half-braidings. Tensoring these pairs makes Z(C) braided; C itself need not be braided.

title: Group
description: A set with an associative binary operation, an identity element, and a two-sided inverse for each element.
